crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that…
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and…
Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

translations.web: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
translations.bsb: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
translations.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare
translations.asv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
